### Ahaz Appeals to Syria
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/ahaz-appeals-to-syria
Passage: 2 Kings 16:7
Points:
- Ahaz faced military invasion from Israel and Syria after refusing their anti-Assyrian coalition.
- God promised deliverance through Isaiah, but Ahaz refused God's sign and turned to Assyria instead.
- Pledging allegiance to a pagan empire led Judah into spiritual compromise and eventual judgment.
- Worldly security cannot replace trusting in the Lord during times of threat and crisis.
- Christians must rehearse God's promises and ask Him for greater faith to trust Him.

### Bible Pathway - May 7
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-may-7-2013.html
Passage: 2 Kings 16:8
Points:
- Ahaz adopted pagan practices and refused to follow the Lord's commands.
- Under siege by Israel and Syria, Ahaz panicked and emptied temple treasuries to bribe Assyria.
- Ahaz stole from God's house rather than repenting and trusting God to deliver Judah.
- Half-hearted devotion to God creates instability across every area of life.
- Believers facing trouble should confess their sins, turn from wrongdoing, and seek God's mercy.
